credits.title: O Homem Que Mordeu o Cão: O Filme
Dorian Gray, or Narcissus Through the Looking Glass
credits.overview: Dorian Gray is but a boy, yet he's worshipped as a God - by the closeted painter who immortalized his beauty, by the libertine who taught him all of the world's secret pleasures, and by himself.
